# 食物｜v1生成提示词

生成方式：内置 imagegen。图像参考仅用于视觉设计，非原游戏3D模型。

## 母图

Use case: stylized-concept. Roblox survival game replacement asset concept in a coherent simplified LOW-POLY 3D family. Chunky bevels, clearly faceted surfaces, matte materials, 5-8 readable main shapes, restrained wear and restrained technology glow. Neutral warm beige studio background, soft shadows, clean complete isolated object, no environment, no real people, no caption, no labels, no watermark. This is visual game concept art, NOT a functional blueprint. No realistic gore, decay, blood, exposed organs or gun cutaways. Do NOT copy square machine plinths or energy generators from style references. NO base or platform unless intrinsically part of edible bowl; maintain appropriate natural silhouette. Create a FAMILY DESIGN MASTER contact sheet, 4 columns, 5 rows, exactly 19 distinct objects, one object per occupied cell, leave remaining cells blank. All cells use same elevated front-right camera and identical material language. Each object complete, clear separation, generous margins. No three views here; ONE view per object. Keep handgrip/attachment dimensions comparable within families; animals retain squirrel < hyena < bear/deathclaw relative sizes, no forced equal real-world height. Composition cell order is LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM. The designs in exact cell order:
1. One curved ram-horn-shaped grey-brown tuber, knobby matte skin and two small sprouts; whole plant root only, no plate.
2. One chunky raw dusky pink meat cut with a small cream fat seam, stylized clean food prop, no blood, no animal body, no plate.
3. One simple dented grey metal bowl of beige stew with TWO mushroom chunks and cubed tuber, minimal steam, no spoon or table.
4. One thick red-pink faceted raw steak with broad cream fat border, simple marbling, no blood, no whole animal, no plate.
5. One cooked dark brown meat cut, same chunky silhouette and cream fat seam as raw hyena meat, TWO grill marks, no raw flesh, no plate.
6. One brown grilled steak with thick golden fat rim, TWO diagonal grill marks and ONE tiny butter cube on top, no plate.
7. One white ceramic bowl of clear golden fish soup, two small fish chunks and THREE pine nuts, tiny herb sprig, no whole fish or cutlery.
8. One thick yellow-brown corn cob with broad stylized kernels and TWO green husk leaves peeled back, matte faceted game prop.
9. One round brown fibrous coconut with flat cream exposed top showing white flesh and pale clear centre, small green leaf fragment; no straw.
10. One edible stylized mushroom, broad tan-brown cap, thick ivory stem and dark simple gills, no soil clump or pot.
11. Small bundle of THREE dark green serrated leaves tied with cream twine, one pale BLUE circular status tag without text, no pills or real drug branding.
12. One deep BLUE glowing mushroom with broad cap, pale thin stem, subtle dark cap spots, no green fog, no cartoon smiling face.
13. THREE toasted brown mushroom caps on ONE short wooden skewer, browned edges and cream stems, clean food prop, no plate.
14. One simple white ceramic bowl of creamy pale orange crab soup with THREE white crab chunks and tiny orange roe garnish, no crab body, no utensils.
15. One clean pink poultry breast-and-leg cut with one small cream bone end, stylized low-poly food prop, no feathers, no blood, no whole bird.
16. One golden-brown cooked poultry breast-and-leg cut with same small cream bone end as raw, two subtle char marks, no plate.
17. One thick dark rose rectangular prime meat slab with TWO broad cream fat stripes, larger cut than basic meat but same inventory scale, no blood or monster body.
18. One thick amber-brown glazed prime roast slab, TWO golden fat stripes and three shallow score cuts, no blood, no plate or side dishes.
19. One yellow-green oval hard fruit with warm golden toasted patches, short brown stalk and ONE small green leaf, no flames or magical steam.
